response_to_summarize: Per composite and radius 0–6 class histogram, n spatial cells, class4 fraction among entire valid radius, and class4 share among nominal marine classes 0,4,5,6 separately (never count land/ice shelf as physically available). Report class5/6 separately. No imputation if zero marine denom.
trend_readout: Descriptive May→pre-image class4 fractions and count of composites with any class4 in 3km mask; do not assert presence for whole season based on single image.
important_limits: 2011 and 2014 are already selected from outcome-exposed annotator notes and are NOT independent confirmatory pairs
Two image negatives from one existing colony, not distinct newly founded colonies
Even independent MODIS class4 does not prove ice thickness, safe access to sea, nesting success, same exact breeding patch or valid colony-year nonoccupancy
Same HDF5 15-day mosaic may include image dates and future days; overlap interval CANNOT serve as independent pre-decision exposure
Boundary/edge classes5/6 and land pixels separately rather than silently reclassifying to fast ice
Do not change frozen composite indices based on observed physical ice values
